responsibility: Defines the interner-agnostic interface that `rustc_type_ir` expects from an inference context, including typing-mode selection, universe management, inference-variable creation and resolution, binder instantiation, equality and subtyping primitives, and region/outlives registration hooks. It also defines the `TypingMode` model that distinguishes coherence, analysis, and post-analysis behavior for normalization and opaque-type handling.
